statement: Enterprise AI contracts are reported to receive prioritized NAND allocation over retail, squeezing consumer SSD availability as Rubin CMX servers scale.
why: Allocation shifting toward AI buyers is an early sign the memory chain is tightening rather than carrying slack inventory.

impact.mechanism: Prioritized allocation to AI server contracts drains available memory inventory across the chain, raising the risk of component shortages for other builds.

evidence.excerpt: surge favors memory manufacturers but likely disadvantages consumer SSD markets near term, as enterprise AI contracts receive prioritized allocation over retail

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet; the related Samsung 60% V-NAND allocation claim is flagged in the same document as an unverified lead and is not used.
